## What this pull request changes

One or two sentences. If it touches sequences, say which ones and where they
came from.

## Biological rationale

> Written by the project owner, in their own words. This is the part that
> cannot be generated, and it is the part that makes the pull request worth
> reading. Say why the biology requires this change, what the alternatives
> were, and which published source supports the choice.

## Provenance

- [ ] Every new sequence has a source recorded in `data/PROVENANCE.md`
- [ ] Every new constant has a citation in its docstring
- [ ] Every new number is reproduced by a test
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes
- [ ] The disclaimer appears on any new user-facing artifact
